card.name: Words just before a number or quantity
card.fires_on: Small words like "over", "in", "divided in", "almost" or "per" that sit right before a count or amount, mostly in dosing and division instructions. Also some measurement phrases in general text.

modes.label: Dose division
modes.description: Linking word before the number of days, sites or parts a dose is split into.
modes.example: Frontalis b 20 Units divided in <<4>> sites Corrugator b 10

modes.label: Duration or span
modes.description: Word or space right before a time length or amount, such as hours or days.
modes.example: Administer at 25 mg/hr over<< >>4 hours. Do not increase the infusion

modes.label: General quantity
modes.description: Approximating or measuring word before a number in non-drug text.
modes.example: Since the beginning of the epidemic, almost<< >>70 million people have been infected with
